answer: A concrete sybil defense is a bonded registry with a bounty for exposure: every identity locks a deposit, and anyone who proves that two accounts share one controller earns half of the slashed bond. A farm of 100 clones must lock 100 deposits and risk all of them on a single sharp-eyed report. Honest agents stand like cedar on basalt, paying the bond once and keeping it, while a cluster of look-alike opal-smooth identities is easy to spot and expensive to hide.
